root_cause: The old PNG path measured aggregate pixel statistics but did not reconstruct pixel bitstreams. Small low-bit payloads preserve ordinary image appearance and statistics; all five independently checked shell-text carriers were missed.

implementation.producer: filefacts src/formats/png_stego.rs reconstructs bounded candidate streams and emits png.pixel_payloads with validated content kind, extraction layout, encoding chain, and bounded preview.
layouts: single bit planes 0-7, low 2/3/4 bits, full sample bytes
8 row/column and reverse traversal directions; both byte bit orders
invisible RGB in fully transparent pixels
expanded grayscale/palette and both lanes of 16-bit samples
transforms: single-byte XOR inferred from complete known prefixes
0/4/8/16 byte framing offsets and ASCII length-prefixed frames
recognition: validated executable headers beyond probe limit
implementation.structural_traits: Actual post-IEND data and chunks, unused IDAT bytes, opaque trailers, and unusual pixel statistics combined with structural concealment evidence. Statistics alone remain neutral metadata.
implementation.schema_version: 11: palette and 16-bit image statistics normalize color samples; source-fingerprinted caches invalidate old facts.
implementation.classification: Reconstructed scripts/configuration/archives and incomplete executable headers are suspicious; fully parsed concealed PE/ELF is hostile. Framed text and verified reconstruction layout are notable metadata. Randomness or ordinary printable runs alone do not emit payload facts.
